description: This file contains unit tests for the Parser class related to accessibility traces with timestamp data. It defines tests that verify the Parser's ability to correctly read trace type, elapsed and real timestamps, and retrieve trace entries.

classes.name: ParserAccessibility
classes.description: Test suite for the Parser class handling accessibility trace data with timestamps.

methods.name: has expected trace type
methods.description: Verifies that the parser correctly identifies the trace type as ACCESSIBILITY.

methods.name: provides elapsed timestamps
methods.description: Checks that the parser correctly retrieves elapsed timestamp data.

methods.name: provides real timestamps
methods.description: Verifies that the parser correctly retrieves real timestamp data.

methods.name: retrieves trace entry
methods.description: Tests that the parser can retrieve a trace entry and its associated timestamp data.

methods.name: provides elapsed timestamps (only)
methods.description: Checks that the parser returns elapsed timestamps when only those are available.

methods.name: doesn't provide real timestamps
methods.description: Verifies parser behavior when real timestamps are not available in the trace.
